subject: Urgent: Forecast impact — pending pricing approvals for Catalyst Retail
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Marks <evan.marks@catalystretail.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast hold — Catalyst Retail pricing approvals needed

Team,

Quick heads up — Catalyst Retail is in the final negotiation stretch but we have two outstanding concession asks that are blocking our ability to mark this as a committed ARR in the finance forecast:

- One-time onboarding credit: 8% of first-year ARR (they asked for it in procurement call).
- T&Cs: procurement wants a 60-day SLA credit clause added to the SOW (legal flagged this).

Both items push the proposal outside of our standard pricing gates. Catalyst is a high-probability opportunity and they told me they need the final quote by EOW Wednesday 7/22 to make the Q3 budget commitment. If we can't land approvals, finance will drop the amount from the committed forecast and it will go to best-effort pipeline.

Actions I need from internal owners by EOD Tuesday 7/21:
- Vanessa: confirm negotiation status and if the onboarding credit is negotiable to a lower percentage.
- Karthik: advise whether the 8% onboarding credit and SLA credit are approvable by deal desk or need Ben's sign-off.

I attached the latest SOW and a small summary of the discount line items for quick review.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evan Marks <evan.marks@catalystretail.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast hold — Catalyst Retail pricing approvals needed

On Mon, Jul 20, 2026 at 9:12 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Quick heads up — Catalyst Retail is in the final negotiation stretch...

Naomi — thanks for flagging. Quick status: procurement pushed back on list price and specifically asked for an 8% onboarding credit and the 60-day SLA credit to be explicit in the SOW. I pushed back on the onboarding number in the call and suggested a 4% cap + a paid onboarding service bundle, but procurement countered that their approval committee wants the higher credit included in the commercial terms.

Evan — to be transparent, if we decline the 8% onboarding credit they may re-open competitive bids. They told me their budget sign-off meeting is Wed morning but could extend by 24 hours with a final quote.

I've attached the SOW (v3) with the redline from procurement and a short note on commercial levers we can use to protect margin. If pricing can approve up to 5% without escalation, I'd recommend we accept 5% now to keep this commitable and then seek Ben for any concession beyond that.

My ask: Karthik, can you (1) confirm the maximum auto-approved concession and (2) if we need Ben looped for >5%?

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Evan Marks <evan.marks@catalystretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast hold — Catalyst Retail pricing approvals needed

Vanessa / Naomi,

Thanks for the transparency. Procurement is on a tight cadence — the exec committee meets Wed 7/22 at 10am PT and they need the final quote and SOW by then. We are willing to be flexible on the SLA wording if legal can provide a short addendum, but the onboarding credit is a material ask for them.

If Redwood can come back with a final commercial that reduces the onboarding credit to 5% and clarifies timeboxed SLA credits (i.e., specific incident caps and a 12-month lookback), we have a strong chance of closing to the originally stated ARR. If you require internal approvals beyond that, please let me know the earliest we can expect sign-off — we may need to push our committee if the timeline slips.

— Evan
Evan Marks
Head of Procurement, Catalyst Retail
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast hold — Catalyst Retail pricing approvals needed

Naomi / Vanessa — I reviewed the ask and the attached tracker. Short answer: deal desk can approve up to a 5% one-time onboarding credit under regional standard concessions for retail verticals without executive escalation. The SLA credit language as requested will need legal to scope (I flagged the proposed 60-day blanket credit as higher risk).

Given the timeline and the impact on the Q3 committed forecast, my recommendation is:
- Approve 5% onboarding credit now (deal desk exercised) so finance can include the amount in the committed ARR for Q3.
- Approve updated SLA addendum limited to specific incident categories (legal will provide the text) — do not accept an open 60-day credit.
- Any concession beyond 5% must be approved by Ben Carter (I have cc'd him).

I've uploaded an updated discount_approval_tracker.csv to the shared drive and attached a local copy to this thread for your records. Vanessa — if you want me to nudge Ben for an expedited review for anything beyond 5%, say the word and I'll escalate.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
-- End of thread --
